description: Use this when the user wants to search for a video they can reuse on a topic, such as ocean waves or a historical film with a free licence. Pass topic words in query, for example {"query": "ocean waves"}, and optionally sources and limit (1 to 5, default 5). Returns up to 5 hits from Wikimedia Commons and the Internet Archive, each with download_url, the licence as the source states it, licence_url and ready-to-paste attribution. When download_kind is directory, download_url is the item's file list; call video_metadata for one direct file. Not for a known item (use video_metadata) or the user's own uploads (use own_video_export). We do not rip videos from social platforms or remove watermarks. A platform URL, a watermark request or a named ripper returns status not_offered with an error.hint and no file.

limit.description: How many videos to return, 5 by default

query.description: Topic words. Example call: {"query": "ocean waves"}. Not a link: a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X or other platform URL returns status not_offered and no file.

sources.description: Which free sources to search: "commons" (Wikimedia Commons), "archive" (Internet Archive) or both. Both when omitted.

name: search_free_videos

as_of.description: Date the sources were read (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)

error.description: Present when status is not ok: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

code.description: Stable code: not_offered, no_results, not_found, not_free or source_unavailable

hint.description: The next step: which tool to call or what input to change

message.description: What went wrong, in one or two sentences

explanation.description: Present when a platform download or watermark removal was asked for

licence_note.description: Reminder that the licence is what the source states

notes.description: Sources that were not searched or could not be read, such as Pexels without a key

attribution.description: Ready to paste next to a reuse of the file

creator.description: Empty when the source names no creator

download_kind.description: file: download_url is the video itself. directory: download_url is the item's file list

download_url.description: When download_kind is file, a direct link to the video file. When it is directory, the Internet Archive list of the item's files; call video_metadata with the item to get one direct file

licence.description: The licence name exactly as the source record states it, such as CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 or Public domain

licence_note.description: Reminder that the licence is what the source states

licence_url.description: Link to the licence text, or empty when the source names the licence without a link

mime.description: Media type of the file, such as video/webm, or null when the source does not state it

page_url.description: The item's page on the source site. Send the user here to check the licence before reuse

title.description: Title as the source record gives it

source.description: The sources read, with their site links

status.description: ok: results found. no_results: nothing freely licensed matched. unavailable: no source could be read, retry later. not_offered: a platform download or watermark removal was asked for, so nothing was searched

title: Search freely licensed video
